svg.title: Electricity Theft Detector
svg.desc: Electricity Theft Detector: Ranks 42,372 smart meters for inspection, with the reasons behind each flag and a plan that pays for itself. 88% of the top 500 flagged were confirmed thieves (rule: 4%).
